parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully sent from the NTP client to the NTP server.

parameters.name: PacketsSentFailed
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that were not successfully sent to the NTP server.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully received by the NTP client from the NTP server.

parameters.name: PacketsDropped
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that were received by the NTP client but were not successfully processed or handled due to errors or other issues.

object.description: This object specifies the statistic parameters for the time client. {{bibref|RFC9249|Chapter 8 NTP Yang Module}}
